content: Ideally, a preferred defense is one with low sensitivity and word error rate. In practice, however, we see that a low error rate often comes at the cost of sensitivity. We see this trade-off in Figure 2 , where we plot WER and sensitivity on the two axes, and depict the robustness when using different backoff variants. Generally, sensitivity is the more dominant factor out of the two, as the error rates of the considered variants are reasonably low.
